basic_info.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Intel Corporation

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description:
Senior Software Engineer and Technical lead for projects related to driver management at Intel.
- Work with senior technical leaders to help scope out projects coming into the team along with comprehending upcoming initiatives and the impacts they will have.
- Collaborate with other team leads and architects to help design solutions for cross team projects and services work impacting my team's projects.
- Help lead the team, providing input and guidance on day to day work as well as still hands on development with Javascript in Vuejs and NodeJs with Express.

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.description:
- Help manage and support the development and evolution of features and capabilities of heavily used tool for driver management using Vuejs and NodeJs with Express.
- Lead development of reusable component library using Vuejs.  Continue managing its maintenance and commits into the repo as it grows.
- Co-Led the development of a new service using GraphQL, Golang and Neo4j that helps track and query hierarchical data related to Intel Drivers.

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.description:
- Received Divisional Recognition Award for outstanding cross organization work solving complex traceability problems in Q3 of 2017.  
- Spun up and built a full fledged bill of materials application in AngularJS utilizing team designed components out of a shared library,  self designed components for application specific needs and specialized services for interacting with our robust API layer.  
- Helped port entire application into Angular/Typescript back in mid 2017 and assisted with the original schema and design for our reusable shared libraries. Continued to design, build and maintain new features and enhancements to the application.
- Helped with the end of life of a prior bill of materials application by helping spec out and make changes to current application's UI.  Along with front end work, helped write new restful services in java for replacing existing services from the prior application and assisting in validation of the data migration by writing SQL validation scripts.
- Started working with Neo4j and cypher, including writing new and innovative services for pulling, querying and displaying bill of materials data, decreasing multiple request times from seconds to milliseconds.
- Set up our application for tracking performance and app usage via New Relic, allowing us to better understand the performance of our app in production as well as overall usage.
- Continually pushed for unit tests within the group, helping lay the ground work within the team by writing some of the first baseline Karma/Jasmine tests and continually improving on the process with test utilities classes and standards to follow for mocking/spying.
- Worked as a team lead on the project for most of my time on it which involved assisting with code reviews for commits into the project, working directly with business partners and product owners to flesh out requirements for new work coming into the team as well as assisting in the interviewing and hiring of new team members.
